system.description:
Secret (tome). Study: a caster with 6th-level spells; 8 weeks, DC 15.

Teaches: breeding one monstrosity with a block (a chimera, manticore, owlbear and the like).

The work: its Level × 500 gp and its Level in weeks, DC 15; the Special Material is the living creatures it is bred from (a chimera takes a lion, a goat and a dragon's blood).

  • It obeys you while it can see you; after a day out of your sight, the GM rolls a d6: on a 1 or 2 it goes wild.
  • Kept by the Red Waste clans that dealt in demonic power, who bred war-beasts for their raids.
  • Some of their strains still run wild.

Monsters & Treasure, Secrets: one of a kind, never sold, placed by the GM. Studied in downtime (Study a Secret); no one can teach it.
